title: Correct stored createdAt for the “Backroads Litter” post so the displayed date matches Australia/Sydney (08 Jan 2026)

requirements.text: Update canister upgrade/migration logic so the existing post titled "Backroads Litter" has its stored `createdAt` corrected to a timestamp that displays as 08 January 2026 in the Australia/Sydney timezone (based on the current date the user provided). This change must update the persisted state so the fix is permanent (not just a frontend formatting change).
acceptanceCriteria: After deploying the updated canister (including any needed migration), fetching posts via `getAllPosts` and `getPost` returns the "Backroads Litter" post with a `createdAt` value that formats to "8 January 2026" using the existing frontend Sydney date formatter.
The fix is applied only to the intended existing post ("Backroads Litter") and does not modify other posts’ `createdAt` values (if present).
The migration/upgrade completes without trapping and preserves all other stored post fields (title, content, isLocked, media).

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend shows the corrected date for the "Backroads Litter" post on both the home feed and the post detail page after the backend `createdAt` migration is applied (no UI regressions to existing date formatting behavior).
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the date shown for "Backroads Litter" renders as "8 January 2026" (Australia/Sydney) using the existing date formatting utility.
On the Post Detail page for "Backroads Litter", the date shown renders as "8 January 2026" (Australia/Sydney) using the existing date formatting utility.
No changes are made that alter date formatting for other posts beyond reflecting the corrected stored timestamp.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; keep all logic in `backend/main.mo` and use `backend/migration.mo` only when upgrading existing state per the conditional migration policy.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Building a general UI to edit or override post dates.
Changing the existing Australia/Sydney frontend date formatting implementation (the issue is the stored timestamp, not formatting).
Integrating any external time/date services or databases.
